messages:
maya: Quick async standup for slice-orbit (canary). TL;DR: ramp started, seeing small latency bump. What I did: rolled slice3 to 3% and applied KV-cache tweak. Blockers: small spike in 95th p99 tail, not sure if it's model or routing. Today: monitoring, might pause ramp if errors move. /cc @alex @jon

alex: Saw the spike too. I increased the batch window for the slice to 8ms to reduce stalls. After change 1-2min later p95 dropped ~60ms. Still watching. No obvious OOMs. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary metrics (slice3):
- start: 03:12 UTC
- current: 3% traffic
- requests/min: 420 r/m
- p50/p95/p99: 45ms / 190ms / 340ms
- errors: 0.18% (baseline 0.05%)

jon: Thanks — can you paste a sample error log? if it's 5xx from runtime vs 502 from gateway matters. Also: any correlation with KV cache hits?

maya: sample error looks like transient inference timeout: 
```
ERROR inference-worker: request 0x9f3a timed out after 2500ms, evicted from pool
```
No gateway 502s. KV cache hit-rate dropped ~8% when the spike started.

priya: Link to runbook? Also which flag controls the traffic slice? Need to coordinate with product for customer-visible rollout.

maya: runbook: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/canary-slice3 (note: internal). Flag: `ff.rollout.slice_orbit` (current: `3`).

tanya: I'll take ownership of the slice watch for the next 30m. I'll pause if errors >0.5% or p99 > 600ms.

alex: Re: actionable pause command (if needed):
```
# pause via redwoodctl
redwoodctl rollout pause --slice slice3
```
or via feature flag API: `POST /flags/ff.rollout.slice_orbit?set=0`

sota: Quick note on ramp: product asked we don't exceed 10% until tomorrow's bake window. If we pause now we should keep stakeholders posted.

jon: If we need more data, run `kubectl logs -n inference -l slice=slice3 --since=10m` and grep for `timed out` — that will show if worker timeouts concentrate on a subset of hosts.

maya: thanks. Action plan: (1) tanya watches, (2) alex monitors batch window / latency, (3) jon will run logs if we see more timeouts, (4) I'll hold on ramp beyond 3% until metrics stabilize. Will update in ~10m. :thumbsup:

tanya: Acknowledged. Ping me in thread for immediate pause. Will also post metrics snapshot before any pause.

deploy-bot: Note: automated fallback is enabled for slice3 -> model-quantized-v2 if errors >0.8% for 5m. Currently not triggered.

maya: Great, thanks all — will post follow-up when I have 10m snapshot.
